newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended lower, under pressure as U.S. Treasury bonds also weakened.
"The Treasury market has weighed on our market, but I wouldn't see this as too significant," one Swiss trader said.
He said there was likely to be some hedging before U.S. economic data this week, including December nonfarm payrolls IZYX on Friday, and this had probably led to selling.

The short end fell early on news the Swiss National Bank had conducted operations for the Swiss federal government to borrow funds. Prices recovered during the day. Swiss traders did not view the move as signaling a change in SNB policy.

The SNB is working "directly as a broker. It is just an intermediary" for the government, one money market specialist said, adding the government was not allowed to leave an account overdrawn, and the SNB was not allowed to directly lend to the government.
Mar Comi medium-term bond steady at 110.80
Mar Euro Swiss francs up one at 98.10.
